summary: Tested the dashboard trio (Report Range, Plate Search, Plate Recognizer credits) in the backend (live API on :8971 plus unit tests) and the frontend (Vite UI at localhost:5173). Existing suites: iter44 6/6, iter42 38/38, iter43 19/20 (1 stale log-format assertion). New file tests/test_iter45_range_search_live.py: 20/21 passed. The only failure is a 366-day limit off-by-one. Every UI flow works and there are no console errors (apart from the /api/frame 404s, which happen because the container has no camera).

minor.issue: Off-by-one: the check `(e - s).days > 366` lets 367 calendar days through (2025-01-01..2026-01-02 is accepted), but the message says 'zyada se zyada 1 saal (366 din)'. Fix: use `(e - s).days >= 366`, i.e. limit by inclusive day count > 366.

Stale assertion. The clog line is now 'daily report {day} (manual) [period]: Entry ...' (changed in commit 7fead76), but the test still looks for 'daily report 2026-09-15 (manual): Entry 7 / Exit 3 -> PROBLEM'. Update the test to match the new format, e.g. with a regex.

'Newest first' relies on ORDER BY id DESC, not timestamp. Events inserted out of order (backfill, imports) would come back in the wrong order, and first_seen/last_seen would be wrong. Consider ORDER BY timestamp DESC, id DESC for the search.
Transient results (connection error / timeout) are cached for 15 min, the same as real results. Consider caching only valid results or HTTP 4xx, or using a short TTL for network errors.

ui_bugs.component: PlateSearchPanel input (also the existing EventsTable small plate filter)
ui_bugs.issue: The search icon overlaps the first characters of the placeholder and typed text. The `.input` class in index.css is declared after `@tailwind utilities` and is not in a layer, so its padding overrides `pl-9`: computed padding-left is 12px. Fix: use `!pl-9`, or move `.input` into `@layer components`.

issues: plate-credits-error shows the raw provider JSON (`[{"detail":"Invalid token.","status_code":403}]`) after the Hindi message. Trim it for the dashboard card.
The plate-search placeholder is cut off at w-96 ('...jaise MH12AB1234 ya 1').

There is a large empty area in the left column under the camera, because the right column is now much taller (credits + load + controls + report card). Consider moving ReportRangeCard below the camera or into the left column.

action_items: Update the stale assertion in test_iter43_report_plate_live.py::test_report_send_no_wa_key to the new clog format.
Fix the search-icon overlap: .input padding overrides pl-9 (use !pl-9 or @layer components).
Optional: order plate search by timestamp; do not cache network errors for 15 min; strip the raw JSON from the credits error text.
critical_code_review_comments: service.py is now 2098 lines; consider splitting the report/plate routes into a separate module.
The range PDF/XLSX endpoints regenerate the file on every GET. This is fine for now, but a 1-year range with many events runs under _report_lock and blocks other report calls.
In the browser path the token is passed in the window.open URL (?t=), the same pattern as the existing snapshots. Acceptable for a local app.
verified: Range JSON: summary math (person count=2, motorcycle -> two_wheeler, gates), days list covers every day with zeros, period text for multi-day and single day, path/pdf_url/xlsx_url, 400 validation (end<start, >1 year, bad date), 401 without token

Range PDF: '9x Security - Report', 'Day-wise (7 days)', 'All events (7)', seeded plates, 'Not detected', 'DD-MM HH:MM AM'; a single day gives 'Daily Report'; an empty range gives 'No Entry/Exit recorded in this period'
Range XLSX: sheets Summary/Day-wise/Events, All gates block, per-gate TOTAL rows, Day-wise with 17 columns, Events header, freeze_panes A2, column widths within 10..48
Plate search: partial match, normalisation, fuzzy flag, newest-first ordering, ZZZZ returns nothing, <2 characters gives 400
Usage: no key, fake key gives HTTP 403 'API key galat hai', cache keeps the same checked_at, refresh=1 forces a re-check, changing the key misses the cache, enabled=false when pr_enabled is off

UI: preset chips set the dates correctly; PDF/Excel buttons call the API, window.open gets a URL that returns a real PDF/XLSX, the success toast shows, report-range-result shows the summary text; end<start shows the error toast

UI search: a 1-char query sends no request; 7777 returns 3 cards newest first with photo / 'photo nahi'; the modal shows the image and plate badge and closes via the X and the backdrop; Enter search, fuzzy hint, 'koi record nahi mila' for ZZZZ, clear button

UI credits: the card is hidden with no key; with the fake key it shows the error, the Settings link opens the Number Plate tab, the refresh spinner shows and sends ?refresh=1, and the OFF pill shows when disabled
Regression: the EventsTable plate filter, stat cards and load meter all work
